children: BioStem Technologies entered a $40 million committed equity facility with Roth Principal Investments and a related Registration Rights Agreement. The facility allows the company, at its discretion, to sell common stock over up to 36 months from Commencement, with purchases priced off VWAP at fixed discounts and subject to a $1.00 threshold price, a 19.99% Nasdaq exchange cap unless priced above a threshold, and a 4.99% ownership cap. BioStem will pay a $400,000 cash commitment fee and expects to use proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes. The registration rights provide for the resale registration of up to 12,050,000 shares and are required for the facility to commence.
